Positive and negative tests capture Stage 1 and Stage 2 DTOs and prove ordinary text/bash/tool evidence remains while raw images, parameterized or wrapped base64, long opaque payloads, secrets, hidden thinking, opaque signatures, default/custom session paths, and excluded bash content do not cross the provider boundary. Provider source and Stage 2 DTOs are bounded.

With explicit owner authorization, cliproxy/gpt-5.6-sol on Pi 0.84.2 completed Stage 1 and Stage 2 for the modified source, published one record and one baseline, accounted provider usage and citation usage, and passed the published-memory secret scan. Candidate-extension discovery was isolated from configured packages to prevent an installed-extension conflict; terminal proof paths close SQLite and remove temporary proof state.

Tests prove unique attempt owners, heartbeat across both provider stages, post-lock expiry checks, expired-run startup recovery, atomic reclaim, orphan pending/building cleanup, stale-owner finish fencing, prior published-head preservation, retry after failure/expiry/supersession, and same-service concurrency exclusion.

scripts/validate-alpine-arm64.sh passed on Alpine 3.24.1 aarch64 with Node v24.18.1 and Pi 0.84.2, including the exact global-install proof.
